ValidationRule.description: This VR checks that the Promo code chosen is valid based on the picklist value on the Account.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(Promotion__c , "Benchmark Churn POC") && NOT ISPICKVAL(Account__r.Churn_Buster_Promotion__c , 'Benchmark Churn POC')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This account is currently not eligible for the Benchmark Churn POC promo. Please reach out to Todd Brydon to qualify the account.
